Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Abhishek Saxena. I am a 53-year-old shopkeeper living in New Delhi. Nikhil Subramanian gave me a cheque for 28.5 lakh rupees to repay a loan, but the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds. My case number is CC/2573/2019 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at New Delhi. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 89941 89927 or email abhishek.saxena@example.com.
